openItems.statement: Parallel/multi-site topology and setup-start coordination are supported; explicit machine-level quantity/capacity assignment remains outside 1.2.0.
Closed-loop return allocation/recovery/disposal is supported; explicit reverse physical transport routing remains outside 1.2.0.
Return quantities are explicit exogenous data in 1.2.0; endogenous return generation is not claimed.
Bitran-Yanasse family support exists structurally; unproven default inverse mappings are intentionally absent.
CatalogOnly and KnownUnsupported capabilities remain explicit non-claims and are not silently promoted by the stable release.
